name: Aras Kebap
kurzbeschreibung: **Aras Kebap in Rum** – Where authentic Turkish flavors meet the heart of Rum, Austria. Just a short walk from the **Innsbruck** city center, this cozy spot serves up mouthwatering **Döner Kebabs**, **Lamb Kebabs**, and other classic dishes. The warm, inviting atmosphere makes it the perfect place to enjoy a delicious meal after exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes or before diving into the vibrant nightlife of Rum. Don’t miss their famous **Pide**—a crispy, cheesy flatbread that’s a must-try! Whether you’re craving a quick bite or a hearty feast, **Aras Kebap** delivers with generous portions and a welcoming smile. A true taste of Turkey in the heart of Rum.
beschreibung: The **Aras Kebap** in **Rum** is the perfect spot for a quick yet delicious bite on the go. With a varied selection of hot and cold snacks, savory treats, and sweet delights, there’s something here for everyone. Every dish is prepared with care and fresh ingredients—whether it’s hearty sausage specialties, crispy schnitzel in a roll, or vegetarian options. The friendly team ensures fast service and a smile on every guest’s face. Perfect for a break while exploring the region, a quick lunch, or a handy snack on the move—**Aras Kebap** delivers solid quality at fair prices in **Rum**.
